{{Quote|I know you're back there and I'm the only one in line! Get out here and help me instead of hiding behind this broken-down droid!|A spacer, to Gitchur Lumpback|<ref name="SWG:MTP" />}}
'''Gitchur Lumpback''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Lumpback operated out of the [[Meatlump Hideout]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. Lumpback dealt with customer complaints concerning the hideout's kissing booth. It was not uncommon for the Meatlump [[drooler]]s, after kissing a customer, to transmit a [[Virus|viral]] infection called [[Meatlump Mono]]. [[Spacer/Legends|Spacers]] who got this infection could go to the Meatlump complaint department, staffed by Lumpback, to demand a refund of their [[Meatlump Lump]]. However, Lumpback would put customers through a bureaucratic process, all the while cowering behind a wooden box, and using a retooled [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] as a customer service intermediary.<ref name="SWG:MTP" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateMeatlump.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Gitchur Lumpback]]
Gitchur Lumpback was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MTP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Gitchur Lumpback was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]," introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>

During each server reset, Lumpback's [[Gender/Legends|gender]] and appearance was randomized, but Lumpback consistently appeared as a Human.<ref name="SWG:MTP" />

The name, Gitchur Lumpback, appears to be a play on the phrase, "get your lump back," as Lumpback's primary function was to refund players their Meatlump Lump should they have been unfortunate enough to contract Meatlump mono.
